description: This class handles deserialization and validation of JSON payloads for creating and updating 'office' entities in the API. It extracts parameters like 'name', 'parentId', 'openingDate', 'externalId', 'locale', and 'dateFormat', and performs validation checks on their presence and format.

classes.name: OfficeCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A deserializer class for validating and extracting data from JSON payloads related to 'office' creation and update commands.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for creating a new office, ensuring required fields are present and correctly formatted.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for updating an existing office, checking optional fields if provided.
